items.question: Trong câu "it is a spectrum of deployment units and boundary strength", từ "spectrum" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it is a spectrum of deployment units and boundary strength", what does "spectrum" (noun) mean?
options: dải liên tục các mức độ
optionsEn: the band of colours in light
items.explanation: spectrum /ˈspek.trəm/ (danh từ): dải liên tục các mức độ. "A spectrum of X" = một dải các mức độ của X, không chỉ có hai cực.
items.explanationEn: spectrum /ˈspek.trəm/ (noun): a continuous range of degrees. "A spectrum of X" means a range of degrees of X, not just two extremes.

items.question: Trong câu "is a false binary — it is a spectrum of deployment units and boundary strength", từ "false binary" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "is a false binary — it is a spectrum of deployment units and boundary strength", what does "false binary" (phrase) mean?
options: lựa chọn hai cực giả tạo
items.explanation: false binary /ˌfɔːls ˈbaɪ.nər.i/ (cụm từ): lựa chọn hai cực giả tạo. Dùng khi ai đó ép chọn "A hoặc B" trong khi thực tế còn nhiều lựa chọn ở giữa.
items.explanationEn: false binary /ˌfɔːls ˈbaɪ.nər.i/ (phrase): a misleading either-or choice. Used when a choice is framed as "A or B" although many options lie in between.

items.question: Trong câu "A microservice owns one business capability and its data, and talks to others only through APIs or events.", từ "capability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A microservice owns one business capability and its data, and talks to others only through APIs or events.", what does "capability" (noun) mean?
options: năng lực, chức năng nghiệp vụ
items.explanation: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): năng lực, chức năng nghiệp vụ. "Business capability" = một năng lực nghiệp vụ như thanh toán, vận chuyển; là cơ sở để chia service.
items.explanationEn: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): a function an organisation performs. "Business capability" is something the business does, such as payments or shipping; it guides service splits.

items.question: Trong câu "all the costs of distribution, none of the benefits.", từ "distribution" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "all the costs of distribution, none of the benefits.", what does "distribution" (noun) mean?
options: sự phân tán trên nhiều máy
optionsEn: spreading a system over many machines
items.explanation: distribution /ˌdɪs.trɪˈbjuː.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự phân tán trên nhiều máy. Trong kiến trúc phần mềm, "distribution" là việc chạy hệ thống trên nhiều tiến trình/máy qua mạng.
items.explanationEn: distribution /ˌdɪs.trɪˈbjuː.ʃən/ (noun): spreading a system over many machines. In software architecture, "distribution" means running a system across processes or machines over a network.

items.question: Trong câu "in-process calls are fast and transactional, and clean module boundaries make a later split cheap.", từ "transactional" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "in-process calls are fast and transactional, and clean module boundaries make a later split cheap.", what does "transactional" (adjective) mean?
options: có tính giao dịch toàn vẹn
optionsEn: not happening at the same time
items.explanation: transactional /trænˈzæk.ʃən.əl/ (tính từ): có tính giao dịch toàn vẹn. Lời gọi "transactional" có thể gói trong một giao dịch: hoặc thành công hết, hoặc hoàn tác hết.
items.explanationEn: transactional /trænˈzæk.ʃən.əl/ (adjective): done as an all-or-nothing unit. A "transactional" call can be wrapped in one transaction: it either fully succeeds or fully rolls back.

items.question: Trong câu "The real drivers are organisational", từ "driver" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The real drivers are organisational", what does "driver" (noun) mean?
options: yếu tố thúc đẩy, động lực
optionsEn: a person who drives a vehicle
items.explanation: driver /ˈdraɪ.vər/ (danh từ): yếu tố thúc đẩy, động lực. "The key drivers of X" = những lý do chính dẫn tới X.
items.explanationEn: driver /ˈdraɪ.vər/ (noun): a factor that causes something. "The key drivers of X" are the main reasons that cause X.

items.question: Trong câu "systems mirror the communication structure of the organisation", từ "mirror" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "systems mirror the communication structure of the organisation", what does "mirror" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mirror /ˈmɪr.ər/ (động từ): phản ánh, giống theo. Định luật Conway: kiến trúc hệ thống "mirror" (phản ánh) cách các nhóm giao tiếp với nhau.
items.explanationEn: mirror /ˈmɪr.ər/ (verb): to closely reflect or copy. Conway's law: system architecture mirrors how the teams communicate.

items.question: Trong câu "independent scaling of hot components, and fault isolation.", từ "isolation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "independent scaling of hot components, and fault isolation.", what does "isolation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: isolation /ˌaɪ.səˈleɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự cô lập, cách ly. "Fault isolation" = cô lập lỗi, để lỗi ở một service không kéo sập các service khác.
items.explanationEn: isolation /ˌaɪ.səˈleɪ.ʃən/ (noun): keeping something separate. "Fault isolation" keeps a failure in one service from bringing down the others.

items.question: Trong câu "Availability multiplies along a synchronous chain", từ "multiply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Availability multiplies along a synchronous chain", what does "multiply" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to breed and grow in number
items.explanation: multiply /ˈmʌl.tɪ.plaɪ/ (động từ): nhân lên với nhau. Độ sẵn sàng của chuỗi lời gọi đồng bộ bằng tích độ sẵn sàng từng service, nên giảm dần.
items.explanationEn: multiply /ˈmʌl.tɪ.plaɪ/ (verb): to combine by multiplication. The availability of a synchronous chain is the product of each service's availability, so it shrinks.

items.question: Trong câu "A bounded context is a part of the domain in which a model has one consistent meaning.", từ "consistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A bounded context is a part of the domain in which a model has one consistent meaning.", what does "consistent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: consistent /kənˈsɪs.tənt/ (tính từ): nhất quán, không đổi. "Consistent meaning" = một nghĩa nhất quán; "consistent with" = phù hợp với.
items.explanationEn: consistent /kənˈsɪs.tənt/ (adjective): the same throughout, not changing. "Consistent meaning" is a single, unchanging meaning; "consistent with" means in agreement with.

items.question: Trong câu "One shared Product model couples all three.", từ "couple" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One shared Product model couples all three.", what does "couple" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to join so they depend on each other
items.explanation: couple /ˈkʌp.əl/ (động từ): gắn chặt, làm phụ thuộc. "Tightly coupled" = gắn chặt; ngược nghĩa là "loosely coupled" hoặc "decoupled".
items.explanationEn: couple /ˈkʌp.əl/ (verb): to join so they depend on each other. "Tightly coupled" means strongly dependent; the opposite is "loosely coupled" or "decoupled".

items.question: Trong câu "High cohesion inside, loose coupling outside — services that always change together are one service.", từ "cohesion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "High cohesion inside, loose coupling outside — services that always change together are one service.", what does "cohesion" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: how closely parts inside belong together
items.explanation: cohesion /kəʊˈhiː.ʒən/ (danh từ): độ gắn kết bên trong. "High cohesion, low coupling" là nguyên tắc thiết kế kinh điển.
items.explanationEn: cohesion /kəʊˈhiː.ʒən/ (noun): how closely parts inside belong together. "High cohesion, low coupling" is a classic design principle.

items.question: Trong câu "Instances come and go, so callers cannot hard-code IPs.", từ "instance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Instances come and go, so callers cannot hard-code IPs.", what does "instance" (noun) mean?
options: một bản chạy của dịch vụ
optionsEn: a single running copy of a program
items.explanation: instance /ˈɪn.stəns/ (danh từ): một bản chạy của dịch vụ. "Service instance" = một bản sao đang chạy của service; có thể có nhiều instance sau load balancer.
items.explanationEn: instance /ˈɪn.stəns/ (noun): a single running copy of a program. A "service instance" is one running copy of a service; many can sit behind a load balancer.

items.question: Trong câu "Instances come and go, so callers cannot hard-code IPs.", từ "hard-code" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Instances come and go, so callers cannot hard-code IPs.", what does "hard-code" (verb) mean?
options: ghi cứng giá trị vào mã
optionsEn: to fix a value directly in code
to look up at run time
items.explanation: hard-code /ˌhɑːdˈkəʊd/ (động từ): ghi cứng giá trị vào mã. Tránh "hard-code" địa chỉ IP, mật khẩu; hãy dùng cấu hình hoặc service discovery.
items.explanationEn: hard-code /ˌhɑːdˈkəʊd/ (verb): to fix a value directly in code. Avoid hard-coding IPs or passwords; use configuration or service discovery instead.

items.question: Trong câu "A registry tracks healthy instances.", từ "registry" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A registry tracks healthy instances.", what does "registry" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an official list of recorded entries
items.explanation: registry /ˈredʒ.ɪ.stri/ (danh từ): sổ đăng ký, danh bạ. "Service registry" = nơi ghi danh các instance đang sống để bên gọi tra cứu.
items.explanationEn: registry /ˈredʒ.ɪ.stri/ (noun): an official list of recorded entries. A "service registry" records live instances so callers can look them up.

items.question: Trong câu "resolves to a ClusterIP and kube-proxy spreads connections across ready Pods.", từ "resolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "resolves to a ClusterIP and kube-proxy spreads connections across ready Pods.", what does "resolve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to translate a name into an address
items.explanation: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (động từ): phân giải thành địa chỉ. "A name resolves to an IP" = tên được DNS phân giải thành địa chỉ IP.
items.explanationEn: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (verb): to translate a name into an address. "A name resolves to an IP" means DNS translates the name into that address.

items.question: Trong câu "Caveat: long-lived gRPC/HTTP/2 connections are balanced per connection, not per request, so one Pod can take all the load", từ "caveat" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Caveat: long-lived gRPC/HTTP/2 connections are balanced per connection, not per request, so one Pod can take all the load", what does "caveat" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a warning to keep in mind
items.explanation: caveat /ˈkæv.i.æt/ (danh từ): điều cần lưu ý. "One caveat is that..." = một điểm cần lưu ý là...; hay gặp trong tài liệu kỹ thuật.
items.explanationEn: caveat /ˈkæv.i.æt/ (noun): a warning to keep in mind. "One caveat is that..." introduces a limitation; it is common in technical docs.

items.question: Trong câu "Caveat: long-lived gRPC/HTTP/2 connections are balanced per connection, not per request, so one Pod can take all the load", từ "long-lived" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Caveat: long-lived gRPC/HTTP/2 connections are balanced per connection, not per request, so one Pod can take all the load", what does "long-lived" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: long-lived /ˌlɒŋˈlɪvd/ (tính từ): tồn tại lâu dài. "Long-lived connection" = kết nối được giữ mở lâu để gửi nhiều request.
items.explanationEn: long-lived /ˌlɒŋˈlɪvd/ (adjective): lasting for a long time. A "long-lived connection" stays open to carry many requests.

items.question: Trong câu "a common reason to adopt a mesh or client-side gRPC balancing.", từ "adopt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a common reason to adopt a mesh or client-side gRPC balancing.", what does "adopt" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take a child as your own
items.explanation: adopt /əˈdɒpt/ (động từ): áp dụng, bắt đầu dùng. "Adopt a tool/practice" = áp dụng một công cụ/cách làm; danh từ là "adoption".
items.explanationEn: adopt /əˈdɒpt/ (verb): to start using a method. "Adopt a tool or practice" means to start using it; the noun is "adoption".

items.question: Trong câu "Rule of thumb: sync for reads the user waits for, async for", từ "rule of thumb" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Rule of thumb: sync for reads the user waits for, async for", what does "rule of thumb" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (cụm từ): quy tắc kinh nghiệm. "As a rule of thumb" = theo kinh nghiệm chung, không phải quy tắc tuyệt đối.
items.explanationEn: rule of thumb /ˌruːl əv ˈθʌm/ (phrase): a practical guideline from experience. "As a rule of thumb" means as a general guide, not a strict rule.

items.question: Trong câu "OrderPlaced triggers email, loyalty points and analytics — none of which should be able to fail checkout.", từ "trigger" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "OrderPlaced triggers email, loyalty points and analytics — none of which should be able to fail checkout.", what does "trigger" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trigger /ˈtrɪɡ.ər/ (động từ): kích hoạt, gây ra. "An event triggers a function" = sự kiện kích hoạt hàm; danh từ "trigger" = tác nhân kích hoạt.
items.explanationEn: trigger /ˈtrɪɡ.ər/ (verb): to cause something to start. "An event triggers a function" means it starts it; as a noun, a "trigger" is what starts something.

items.question: Trong câu "Brokers and delivery guarantees are topic 11; API styles are topic 17.", từ "guarantee" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Brokers and delivery guarantees are topic 11; API styles are topic 17.", what does "guarantee" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a firm promise that something happens
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (danh từ): sự bảo đảm. "Delivery guarantee" = mức bảo đảm giao tin nhắn, ví dụ at-least-once, exactly-once.
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡær.ənˈtiː/ (noun): a firm promise that something happens. A "delivery guarantee" is how surely a message arrives, e.g. at-least-once or exactly-once.

items.question: Trong câu "Every remote call needs one; a slow dependency that holds your threads is worse than a dead one.", từ "dependency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every remote call needs one; a slow dependency that holds your threads is worse than a dead one.", what does "dependency" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a component your system relies on
items.explanation: dependency /dɪˈpen.dən.si/ (danh từ): thành phần mình phụ thuộc. "Downstream dependency" = service mà mình gọi tới; nếu nó chậm, mình cũng chậm theo.
items.explanationEn: dependency /dɪˈpen.dən.si/ (noun): a component your system relies on. A "downstream dependency" is a service you call; if it slows down, so do you.

items.question: Trong câu "if the edge allows 2 s, inner calls must fit inside that budget (deadline propagation — gRPC does it natively).", từ "propagation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "if the edge allows 2 s, inner calls must fit inside that budget (deadline propagation — gRPC does it natively).", what does "propagation" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: passing something on down a chain
items.explanation: propagation /ˌprɒp.əˈɡeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự truyền tiếp xuống chuỗi. "Deadline propagation" = truyền hạn chót từ lời gọi ngoài xuống các lời gọi bên trong.
items.explanationEn: propagation /ˌprɒp.əˈɡeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): passing something on down a chain. "Deadline propagation" passes the outer deadline down to inner calls.

items.question: Trong câu "Retry only transient errors (timeouts, 503, 429 honouring Retry-After), never 400/401/404, and only idempotent operations (or use an idempotency key).", từ "transient" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Retry only transient errors (timeouts, 503, 429 honouring Retry-After), never 400/401/404, and only idempotent operations (or use an idempotency key).", what does "transient" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: transient /ˈtræn.zi.ənt/ (tính từ): tạm thời, thoáng qua. "Transient error" = lỗi tạm thời, thử lại có thể thành công; trái với "permanent error".
items.explanationEn: transient /ˈtræn.zi.ənt/ (adjective): lasting only a short time. A "transient error" is temporary and may succeed on retry; the opposite is a "permanent error".

items.question: Trong câu "Retry only transient errors (timeouts, 503, 429 honouring Retry-After), never 400/401/404, and only idempotent operations (or use an idempotency key).", từ "idempotent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Retry only transient errors (timeouts, 503, 429 honouring Retry-After), never 400/401/404, and only idempotent operations (or use an idempotency key).", what does "idempotent" (adjective) mean?
options: lặp lại vẫn cùng kết quả
items.explanation: idempotent /ˌaɪ.dəmˈpəʊ.tənt/ (tính từ): lặp lại vẫn cùng kết quả. Thao tác "idempotent" (như PUT, DELETE) an toàn khi thử lại; danh từ là "idempotency".
items.explanationEn: idempotent /ˌaɪ.dəmˈpəʊ.tənt/ (adjective): same result however often repeated. An idempotent operation (like PUT or DELETE) is safe to retry; the noun is "idempotency".

items.question: Trong câu "Retry only transient errors (timeouts, 503, 429 honouring Retry-After), never 400/401/404, and only idempotent operations (or use an idempotency key).", từ "honour" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Retry only transient errors (timeouts, 503, 429 honouring Retry-After), never 400/401/404, and only idempotent operations (or use an idempotency key).", what does "honour" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: honour /ˈɒn.ər/ (động từ): tôn trọng và làm theo. "Honour a header/contract" = làm đúng theo header/hợp đồng đó; Mỹ viết "honor".
items.explanationEn: honour /ˈɒn.ər/ (verb): to respect and follow. "Honour a header or contract" means to obey it; American spelling is "honor".

items.question: Trong câu "Use exponential backoff with jitter so clients do not retry in lockstep.", từ "jitter" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use exponential backoff with jitter so clients do not retry in lockstep.", what does "jitter" (noun) mean?
options: độ lệch ngẫu nhiên thời gian
items.explanation: jitter /ˈdʒɪt.ər/ (danh từ): độ lệch ngẫu nhiên thời gian. Thêm "jitter" vào thời gian chờ để các client không thử lại cùng một lúc.
items.explanationEn: jitter /ˈdʒɪt.ər/ (noun): small random variation in timing. Adding jitter to wait times stops clients from retrying at the same instant.

items.question: Trong câu "to the bottom service, just when it is struggling.", từ "struggle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "to the bottom service, just when it is struggling.", what does "struggle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: struggle /ˈstrʌɡ.əl/ (động từ): chật vật, gặp khó khăn. "A struggling service" = service đang quá tải, xử lý khó khăn.
items.explanationEn: struggle /ˈstrʌɡ.əl/ (verb): to have great difficulty. A "struggling service" is overloaded and barely coping.

items.question: Trong câu "Retry at one layer and cap extra load with a retry budget", từ "cap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Retry at one layer and cap extra load with a retry budget", what does "cap" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to set an upper limit on
items.explanation: cap /kæp/ (động từ): giới hạn mức tối đa. "Cap X at N" = giới hạn X tối đa là N; danh từ "cap" = mức trần.
items.explanationEn: cap /kæp/ (verb): to set an upper limit on. "Cap X at N" means X may not go above N; as a noun, a "cap" is the ceiling.

items.question: Trong câu "callers fail fast instead of stacking up timeouts, and the dependency gets room to recover.", từ "recover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "callers fail fast instead of stacking up timeouts, and the dependency gets room to recover.", what does "recover" (verb) mean?
options: phục hồi trạng thái bình thường
optionsEn: to return to a normal state
to get back a lost item
items.explanation: recover /rɪˈkʌv.ər/ (động từ): phục hồi trạng thái bình thường. "Give a service room to recover" = giảm tải để service kịp phục hồi; danh từ "recovery".
items.explanationEn: recover /rɪˈkʌv.ər/ (verb): to return to a normal state. "Give a service room to recover" means easing load so it can heal; the noun is "recovery".

items.question: Trong câu "A bulkhead isolates resources like watertight compartments", từ "compartment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A bulkhead isolates resources like watertight compartments", what does "compartment" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a separate section inside a space
items.explanation: compartment /kəmˈpɑːt.mənt/ (danh từ): khoang, ngăn riêng biệt. "Watertight compartments" = các khoang kín nước trên tàu; thủng một khoang, tàu vẫn nổi.
items.explanationEn: compartment /kəmˈpɑːt.mənt/ (noun): a separate section inside a space. "Watertight compartments" are sealed ship sections; one can flood while the ship stays afloat.

items.question: Trong câu "so a hanging recommendations service can exhaust only its own 20 slots while checkout keeps working.", từ "exhaust" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "so a hanging recommendations service can exhaust only its own 20 slots while checkout keeps working.", what does "exhaust" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: exhaust /ɪɡˈzɔːst/ (động từ): dùng cạn hết. "Exhaust a connection pool" = dùng hết kết nối trong pool; tính từ "exhausted".
items.explanationEn: exhaust /ɪɡˈzɔːst/ (verb): to use up completely. "Exhaust a connection pool" means every connection is in use; the adjective is "exhausted".

items.question: Trong câu "A fallback is what you return instead: cached data, a default, a degraded response, or a clear error.", từ "degraded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A fallback is what you return instead: cached data, a default, a degraded response, or a clear error.", what does "degraded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: degraded /dɪˈɡreɪ.dɪd/ (tính từ): bị suy giảm chất lượng. "Degraded mode" = chế độ chạy giảm chức năng nhưng vẫn phục vụ được người dùng.
items.explanationEn: degraded /dɪˈɡreɪ.dɪd/ (adjective): reduced in quality. "Degraded mode" means running with reduced features while still serving users.

items.question: Trong câu "spans three databases, so one ACID transaction is impossible.", từ "span" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "spans three databases, so one ACID transaction is impossible.", what does "span" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: span /spæn/ (động từ): trải rộng qua. "A transaction spans several services" = giao dịch trải qua nhiều service.
items.explanationEn: span /spæn/ (verb): to extend across. "A transaction spans several services" means it extends across them.

items.question: Trong câu "holds locks across services, blocks if the coordinator dies, and is unsupported by most brokers and NoSQL stores.", từ "coordinator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "holds locks across services, blocks if the coordinator dies, and is unsupported by most brokers and NoSQL stores.", what does "coordinator" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the party that organises the others
items.explanation: coordinator /kəʊˈɔː.dɪ.neɪ.tər/ (danh từ): bên điều phối. Trong 2PC, "coordinator" hỏi các bên có sẵn sàng commit không rồi ra lệnh commit/abort.
items.explanationEn: coordinator /kəʊˈɔː.dɪ.neɪ.tər/ (noun): the party that organises the others. In 2PC the coordinator asks participants if they can commit, then orders commit or abort.

items.question: Trong câu "holds locks across services, blocks if the coordinator dies, and is unsupported by most brokers and NoSQL stores.", từ "block" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "holds locks across services, blocks if the coordinator dies, and is unsupported by most brokers and NoSQL stores.", what does "block" (verb) mean?
options: bị treo chờ, không tiến tiếp
optionsEn: to stop a ball in sport
items.explanation: block /blɒk/ (động từ): bị treo chờ, không tiến tiếp. "Blocking call" = lời gọi làm tiến trình đứng chờ; trái nghĩa "non-blocking".
items.explanationEn: block /blɒk/ (verb): to stop progressing while waiting. A "blocking call" makes the caller wait; the opposite is "non-blocking".

items.question: Trong câu "If a step fails, compensating transactions semantically undo the earlier ones.", từ "semantically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If a step fails, compensating transactions semantically undo the earlier ones.", what does "semantically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: semantically /sɪˈmæn.tɪ.kli/ (trạng từ): về mặt ý nghĩa. "Semantically undo" = hoàn tác về ý nghĩa nghiệp vụ (ví dụ hoàn tiền), không xóa dữ liệu thật.
items.explanationEn: semantically /sɪˈmæn.tɪ.kli/ (adverb): in terms of meaning. "Semantically undo" means reversing the business meaning (e.g. a refund), not erasing records.

items.question: Trong câu "If a step fails, compensating transactions semantically undo the earlier ones.", từ "compensate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If a step fails, compensating transactions semantically undo the earlier ones.", what does "compensate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: compensate /ˈkɒm.pən.seɪt/ (động từ): bù đắp, bù trừ. "Compensate for X" = bù lại cho X; "compensating transaction" = giao dịch bù.
items.explanationEn: compensate /ˈkɒm.pən.seɪt/ (verb): to make up for something. "Compensate for X" means to make up for X; a "compensating transaction" offsets an earlier one.

items.question: Trong câu "No isolation: others can see intermediate states.", từ "intermediate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "No isolation: others can see intermediate states.", what does "intermediate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: intermediate /ˌɪn.təˈmiː.di.ət/ (tính từ): ở giữa, trung gian. "Intermediate state" = trạng thái dở dang giữa lúc bắt đầu và kết thúc.
items.explanationEn: intermediate /ˌɪn.təˈmiː.di.ət/ (adjective): between two stages. An "intermediate state" lies between the start and the end of a process.

items.question: Trong câu "Put non-reversible steps last — after the pivot transaction the saga only moves forward.", từ "reversible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Put non-reversible steps last — after the pivot transaction the saga only moves forward.", what does "reversible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reversible /rɪˈvɜː.sə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể đảo ngược. "Non-reversible step" = bước không thể hoàn tác (ví dụ gửi hàng), nên đặt cuối saga.
items.explanationEn: reversible /rɪˈvɜː.sə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be undone. A "non-reversible step" cannot be undone (e.g. shipping), so it goes last in a saga.

items.question: Trong câu "Put non-reversible steps last — after the pivot transaction the saga only moves forward.", từ "pivot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Put non-reversible steps last — after the pivot transaction the saga only moves forward.", what does "pivot" (noun) mean?
options: điểm then chốt không quay lại
optionsEn: the key point of no return
items.explanation: pivot /ˈpɪv.ət/ (danh từ): điểm then chốt không quay lại. "Pivot transaction" = giao dịch then chốt trong saga; sau nó chỉ còn các bước chắc chắn thành công.
items.explanationEn: pivot /ˈpɪv.ət/ (noun): the key point of no return. The "pivot transaction" is the saga's go/no-go point; after it, steps only move forward.

items.question: Trong câu "Every step and compensation must be idempotent, because messages are redelivered.", từ "redeliver" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every step and compensation must be idempotent, because messages are redelivered.", what does "redeliver" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: redeliver /ˌriː.dɪˈlɪv.ər/ (động từ): gửi lại lần nữa. Broker có thể "redeliver" tin nhắn khi chưa nhận được xác nhận, nên handler phải idempotent.
items.explanationEn: redeliver /ˌriː.dɪˈlɪv.ər/ (verb): to deliver again. A broker may redeliver a message when no acknowledgement arrives, so handlers must be idempotent.

items.question: Trong câu "Saving state and publishing the event atomically needs the outbox pattern (topic 11).", từ "atomically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Saving state and publishing the event atomically needs the outbox pattern (topic 11).", what does "atomically" (adverb) mean?
options: như một khối không thể tách
items.explanation: atomically /əˈtɒm.ɪ.kli/ (trạng từ): như một khối không thể tách. "Atomically" = cả hai việc cùng thành công hoặc cùng thất bại; tính từ "atomic".
items.explanationEn: atomically /əˈtɒm.ɪ.kli/ (adverb): as one indivisible operation. "Atomically" means both actions succeed or both fail; the adjective is "atomic".

items.question: Trong câu "is a natural orchestrator, while EventBridge or SNS/SQS suits choreography.", từ "suit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "is a natural orchestrator, while EventBridge or SNS/SQS suits choreography.", what does "suit" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to dress in a formal jacket
to get in the way of
items.explanation: suit /suːt/ (động từ): phù hợp với. "X suits Y" = X phù hợp với Y; "well suited to" = rất phù hợp cho.
items.explanationEn: suit /suːt/ (verb): to be right for. "X suits Y" means X fits Y well; "well suited to" means very appropriate for.

items.question: Trong câu "CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) separates the write model (commands, invariants) from read models shaped for queries.", từ "segregation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CQRS (Command Query Responsibility Segregation) separates the write model (commands, invariants) from read models shaped for queries.", what does "segregation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: segregation /ˌseɡ.rɪˈɡeɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự tách riêng. "Command Query Responsibility Segregation" = tách riêng trách nhiệm ghi (command) và đọc (query).
items.explanationEn: segregation /ˌseɡ.rɪˈɡeɪ.ʃən/ (noun): keeping things apart. In CQRS, "segregation" means keeping write (command) and read (query) responsibilities apart.

items.question: Trong câu "separates the write model (commands, invariants) from read models shaped for queries.", từ "invariant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "separates the write model (commands, invariants) from read models shaped for queries.", what does "invariant" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a rule that must always hold
items.explanation: invariant /ɪnˈveə.ri.ənt/ (danh từ): quy tắc luôn phải đúng. Ví dụ "invariant": số dư tài khoản không được âm; write model phải bảo vệ nó.
items.explanationEn: invariant /ɪnˈveə.ri.ənt/ (noun): a rule that must always hold. An example invariant: a balance must never go negative; the write model enforces it.

items.question: Trong câu "It lets reads and writes scale independently and lets a projection combine data from several services' events without cross-service calls.", từ "independently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It lets reads and writes scale independently and lets a projection combine data from several services' events without cross-service calls.", what does "independently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: independently /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách độc lập. "Scale independently" = mở rộng từng phần riêng mà không ảnh hưởng phần khác.
items.explanationEn: independently /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt.li/ (adverb): without depending on each other. "Scale independently" means growing one part without touching the others.

items.question: Trong câu "It lets reads and writes scale independently and lets a projection combine data from several services' events without cross-service calls.", từ "projection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It lets reads and writes scale independently and lets a projection combine data from several services' events without cross-service calls.", what does "projection" (noun) mean?
options: mô hình đọc dựng từ sự kiện
optionsEn: a read view built from events
items.explanation: projection /prəˈdʒek.ʃən/ (danh từ): mô hình đọc dựng từ sự kiện. Trong CQRS, "projection" đọc luồng sự kiện và cập nhật bảng phục vụ truy vấn.
items.explanationEn: projection /prəˈdʒek.ʃən/ (noun): a read view built from events. In CQRS a projection reads the event stream and updates tables shaped for queries.

items.question: Trong câu "Cost: reads are eventually consistent and there are more moving parts.", từ "eventually consistent" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cost: reads are eventually consistent and there are more moving parts.", what does "eventually consistent" (phrase) mean?

items.explanation: eventually consistent /ɪˈven.tʃu.ə.li kənˈsɪs.tənt/ (cụm từ): sau một lúc mới nhất quán. "Eventually consistent" = dữ liệu có thể cũ trong chốc lát rồi mới khớp; "eventually" ≠ "có lẽ".
items.explanationEn: eventually consistent /ɪˈven.tʃu.ə.li kənˈsɪs.tənt/ (phrase): becoming consistent after a delay. "Eventually consistent" data may be stale briefly before it matches; "eventually" means in the end.

items.question: Trong câu "Cost: reads are eventually consistent and there are more moving parts.", từ "moving parts" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cost: reads are eventually consistent and there are more moving parts.", what does "moving parts" (phrase) mean?
options: bộ phận cơ khí chuyển động
items.explanation: moving parts /ˌmuː.vɪŋ ˈpɑːts/ (cụm từ): thành phần phải vận hành. "More moving parts" = nhiều thành phần hơn, nghĩa là nhiều chỗ có thể hỏng.
items.explanationEn: moving parts /ˌmuː.vɪŋ ˈpɑːts/ (phrase): components that must work together. "More moving parts" means more components, and so more things that can break.

items.question: Trong câu "Event sourcing stores the sequence of events as the source of truth; current state is derived by replaying them", từ "derive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Event sourcing stores the sequence of events as the source of truth; current state is derived by replaying them", what does "derive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (động từ): suy ra, tính ra từ. "Derived from X" = được tính ra từ X; "derived data" = dữ liệu dẫn xuất.
items.explanationEn: derive /dɪˈraɪv/ (verb): to obtain from a source. "Derived from X" means computed from X; "derived data" is built from other data.

items.question: Trong câu "Event sourcing stores the sequence of events as the source of truth; current state is derived by replaying them", từ "replay" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Event sourcing stores the sequence of events as the source of truth; current state is derived by replaying them", what does "replay" (verb) mean?
options: xử lý lại theo thứ tự
items.explanation: replay /ˌriːˈpleɪ/ (động từ): xử lý lại theo thứ tự. "Replay events" = chạy lại toàn bộ sự kiện từ đầu để dựng lại trạng thái.
items.explanationEn: replay /ˌriːˈpleɪ/ (verb): to process again in order. "Replay events" means running them again from the start to rebuild state.

items.question: Trong câu "CQRS without event sourcing is common; event sourcing almost always implies CQRS.", từ "imply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CQRS without event sourcing is common; event sourcing almost always implies CQRS.", what does "imply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: imply /ɪmˈplaɪ/ (động từ): kéo theo, dẫn tới cần. "A implies B" = có A thì gần như phải có B; danh từ "implication".
items.explanationEn: imply /ɪmˈplaɪ/ (verb): to make something necessary. "A implies B" means having A brings B with it; the noun is "implication".

items.question: Trong câu "Apply them to the bounded contexts that need them (ledgers, bookings), not system-wide.", từ "ledger" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Apply them to the bounded contexts that need them (ledgers, bookings), not system-wide.", what does "ledger" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ledger /ˈledʒ.ər/ (danh từ): sổ cái ghi giao dịch. "Ledger" chỉ ghi thêm, không sửa; rất hợp với event sourcing.
items.explanationEn: ledger /ˈledʒ.ər/ (noun): a book of financial records. A ledger is append-only, never edited, which fits event sourcing well.

items.question: Trong câu "A service mesh moves network concerns out of application code.", từ "concern" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: concern /kənˈsɜːn/ (danh từ): khía cạnh trách nhiệm kỹ thuật. "Separation of concerns" = tách các khía cạnh (mạng, bảo mật, nghiệp vụ) ra khỏi nhau.
items.explanationEn: concern /kənˈsɜːn/ (noun): an area of technical responsibility. "Separation of concerns" keeps aspects such as networking, security and business logic apart.

items.question: Trong câu "retries and timeouts, outlier detection, traffic splitting for canaries, uniform metrics and traces.", từ "uniform" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "retries and timeouts, outlier detection, traffic splitting for canaries, uniform metrics and traces.", what does "uniform" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: uniform /ˈjuː.nɪ.fɔːm/ (tính từ): đồng nhất, như nhau. "Uniform metrics" = số liệu đo cùng một định dạng cho mọi service.
items.explanationEn: uniform /ˈjuː.nɪ.fɔːm/ (adjective): the same everywhere. "Uniform metrics" share one format across every service.

items.question: Trong câu "retries and timeouts, outlier detection, traffic splitting for canaries, uniform metrics and traces.", từ "outlier" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "retries and timeouts, outlier detection, traffic splitting for canaries, uniform metrics and traces.", what does "outlier" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outlier /ˈaʊt.laɪ.ər/ (danh từ): phần tử bất thường. "Outlier detection" = phát hiện instance lỗi bất thường để loại khỏi vòng cân bằng tải.
items.explanationEn: outlier /ˈaʊt.laɪ.ər/ (noun): something far from the rest. "Outlier detection" spots unusually failing instances and removes them from load balancing.

items.question: Trong câu "Worth it with many services and polyglot teams; overkill for five.", từ "polyglot" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Worth it with many services and polyglot teams; overkill for five.", what does "polyglot" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: polyglot /ˈpɒl.i.ɡlɒt/ (tính từ): dùng nhiều ngôn ngữ. "Polyglot teams/persistence" = các nhóm dùng nhiều ngôn ngữ lập trình / nhiều loại DB.
items.explanationEn: polyglot /ˈpɒl.i.ɡlɒt/ (adjective): using many languages. "Polyglot teams" use many programming languages; "polyglot persistence" uses many databases.

items.question: Trong câu "Worth it with many services and polyglot teams; overkill for five.", từ "overkill" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Worth it with many services and polyglot teams; overkill for five.", what does "overkill" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: overkill /ˈəʊ.və.kɪl/ (danh từ): sự quá mức cần thiết. "X is overkill for Y" = X quá nặng nề, thừa thãi so với nhu cầu của Y.
items.explanationEn: overkill /ˈəʊ.və.kɪl/ (noun): more than is needed. "X is overkill for Y" means X is far heavier than Y needs.

items.question: Trong câu "the operational tax exceeds the autonomy gain.", từ "exceed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanation: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (động từ): vượt quá. "Costs exceed benefits" = chi phí vượt quá lợi ích; danh từ "excess".
items.explanationEn: exceed /ɪkˈsiːd/ (verb): to be greater than. "Costs exceed benefits" means costs are larger; the related noun is "excess".

items.question: Trong câu "the operational tax exceeds the autonomy gain.", từ "autonomy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: autonomy /ɔːˈtɒn.ə.mi/ (noun): freedom to act independently. "Team autonomy" lets a team decide and deploy on its own; the adjective is "autonomous".

items.question: Trong câu "CI/CD, containers, monitoring and tracing are immature.", từ "immature" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CI/CD, containers, monitoring and tracing are immature.", what does "immature" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: immature /ˌɪm.əˈtʃʊər/ (tính từ): chưa hoàn thiện. "Immature tooling" = công cụ, quy trình còn sơ khai; trái nghĩa "mature".
items.explanationEn: immature /ˌɪm.əˈtʃʊər/ (adjective): not yet fully developed. "Immature tooling" is still basic and unreliable; the opposite is "mature".

items.question: Trong câu "granularity is a per-workload choice.", từ "granularity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "granularity is a per-workload choice.", what does "granularity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: granularity /ˌɡræn.jəˈlær.ə.ti/ (danh từ): mức độ chia nhỏ. "Fine-grained" = chia rất nhỏ; "coarse-grained" = chia thô, khối lớn.
items.explanationEn: granularity /ˌɡræn.jəˈlær.ə.ti/ (noun): how finely something is divided. "Fine-grained" means split into small pieces; "coarse-grained" means large chunks.

items.question: Trong câu "put a router in front, extract one capability (with its data) at a time, redirect its routes, and delete the old code.", từ "extract" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "put a router in front, extract one capability (with its data) at a time, redirect its routes, and delete the old code.", what does "extract" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take out of a larger whole
items.explanation: extract /ɪkˈstrækt/ (động từ): tách ra khỏi khối lớn. "Extract a service from the monolith" = tách một phần của monolith thành service riêng.
items.explanationEn: extract /ɪkˈstrækt/ (verb): to take out of a larger whole. "Extract a service from the monolith" means pulling one part out into its own service.

items.question: Trong câu "An anti-corruption layer translates between the legacy model and the new service so old concepts do not leak in.", từ "legacy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An anti-corruption layer translates between the legacy model and the new service so old concepts do not leak in.", what does "legacy" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: left to someone in a will
items.explanation: legacy /ˈleɡ.ə.si/ (tính từ): cũ nhưng vẫn đang dùng. "Legacy system" = hệ thống cũ vẫn chạy, khó thay thế.
items.explanationEn: legacy /ˈleɡ.ə.si/ (adjective): old but still in use. A "legacy system" is old software that still runs and is hard to replace.

items.question: Trong câu "An anti-corruption layer translates between the legacy model and the new service so old concepts do not leak in.", từ "leak" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An anti-corruption layer translates between the legacy model and the new service so old concepts do not leak in.", what does "leak" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to get in without being intended
items.explanation: leak /liːk/ (động từ): lọt vào ngoài ý muốn. "Leak in/into" = lọt vào; "leaky abstraction" = lớp trừu tượng để lộ chi tiết bên trong.
items.explanationEn: leak /liːk/ (verb): to get in without being intended. "Leak into" means to slip in; a "leaky abstraction" exposes details it should hide.

items.question: Trong câu "split for team and deployment independence, not performance.", từ "independence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "split for team and deployment independence, not performance.", what does "independence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: independence /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dəns/ (danh từ): sự độc lập. "Deployment independence" = mỗi service có thể triển khai riêng không cần chờ service khác.
items.explanationEn: independence /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dəns/ (noun): freedom from reliance on others. "Deployment independence" means each service ships without waiting for others.

items.question: Trong câu "Independent deployability defines microservices; bounded contexts and database per service keep them decoupled.", từ "decoupled" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Independent deployability defines microservices; bounded contexts and database per service keep them decoupled.", what does "decoupled" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: decoupled /diːˈkʌp.əld/ (tính từ): tách rời, ít phụ thuộc. "Decoupled services" có thể thay đổi và triển khai riêng; động từ "decouple".
items.explanationEn: decoupled /diːˈkʌp.əld/ (adjective): not tightly connected. "Decoupled services" can change and deploy separately; the verb is "decouple".

items.question: Trong câu "Resilience patterns stop partial failure from cascading; sagas replace distributed transactions.", từ "cascade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Resilience patterns stop partial failure from cascading; sagas replace distributed transactions.", what does "cascade" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to spread from one to the next
items.explanation: cascade /kæˈskeɪd/ (động từ): lan truyền dây chuyền. "Cascading failure" = lỗi dây chuyền, một service hỏng kéo theo các service khác.
items.explanationEn: cascade /kæˈskeɪd/ (verb): to spread from one to the next. A "cascading failure" is when one failing service drags down others.

items.question: Trong câu "Resilience patterns stop partial failure from cascading; sagas replace distributed transactions.", từ "resilience" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Resilience patterns stop partial failure from cascading; sagas replace distributed transactions.", what does "resilience" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the ability to grow in size
items.explanation: resilience /rɪˈzɪl.i.əns/ (danh từ): khả năng chống chịu lỗi. "Resilience patterns" gồm timeout, retry, circuit breaker, bulkhead; tính từ "resilient".
items.explanationEn: resilience /rɪˈzɪl.i.əns/ (noun): the ability to withstand failure. "Resilience patterns" include timeouts, retries, circuit breakers and bulkheads; the adjective is "resilient".

items.question: Trong câu "CQRS, event sourcing and service meshes are targeted tools, not defaults; the strangler fig moves a monolith safely.", từ "targeted" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CQRS, event sourcing and service meshes are targeted tools, not defaults; the strangler fig moves a monolith safely.", what does "targeted" (adjective) mean?
options: nhắm vào nhu cầu cụ thể
items.explanation: targeted /ˈtɑː.ɡɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): nhắm vào nhu cầu cụ thể. "Targeted tool/fix" = công cụ/bản sửa dùng cho đúng chỗ cần, không áp dụng tràn lan.
items.explanationEn: targeted /ˈtɑː.ɡɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): aimed at a specific need. A "targeted tool" or fix is applied only where it is needed, not everywhere.
